profit_factor_method: For each completed canonical-sleeve net trade, net P&L equals quantity times executed exit price minus exit fee, less quantity times executed entry price plus entry fee. Profit factor is total positive net P&L divided by absolute total negative net P&L.

signal_funnel.canonicalization: payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators for exactly {identity_kind,identities}; identities retain listed order
